_note: Retuned for VR_Mechanics's actual rig (not the desktop prototype these numbers came from). There is no jump: ContinuousMovementPhysics is a flat thumbstick glide, and the only real way to cross a gap or climb is Grappling.cs's spring-joint pull (maxDistance 25, see Assets/Scripts/Grappling.cs). jumpGapMax/jumpUpMax are left tiny (stepping onto a touching/adjoining piece), not a real jump - almost every transition will be grapple-required by design, which matches this game. Playtest a few generated levels, then adjust further.
